name: Siddhika Coatings Ltd.
summary: Siddhika Coatings Ltd. is an Indian company specializing in surface finishing solutions, operating as an authorized marketing agent and strategic channel partner for SK Kaken Ltd. (SKK), a Japanese manufacturer of coatings and pigments. The company's business model integrates product distribution with application services, offering a range of architectural coatings, specialized textures such as Ceraskken and Eleganstone, and high-performance paint systems including functional coatings like heat-reflective and anti-fungal paints, as well as oil paints, distempers, and enamels. Siddhika Coatings provides end-to-end application services for civil structures, covering interior and exterior surfaces, surface preparation, primer application, and specialized finish application. Their services also extend to facade paint contracts and comprehensive renovation jobs. The company primarily targets the real estate and commercial construction sectors, serving architects, real estate developers, government and private entities, major institutions, IT companies, business park developers, and hospitality leaders across various states in India, including major metropolitan areas and expanding into Tier-2 cities.
